newsitem.title: USA: November U.S. light vehicle sales fall 1.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: November U.S. light vehicle sales fall 1.6 pct.

text.p: With all automakers reporting, U.S. car and light truck sales during November totaled 1,125,582 vehicles, a 1.6 percent drop from 1,144,448 a year earlier.

The seasonally adjusted annual sales rate for the month was 14.94 million, up from 14.81 million a year earlier and 14.93 million for October. The rate is calculated with seasonal factors supplied by the U.S. Commerce Department.
For the first 11 months of 1996, automakers sold 14,010,647 light vehicles, compared with 13,590,795 a year earlier.
Automakers sold 486,407 North American-built cars in the United States in November, down 9.7 percent from a year ago.
The seasonally adjusted annual rate for domestic cars was 6.5 million, compared with 7.0 million in November 1994 and 6.5 million in October.

Automakers sold 494,166 domestic trucks in the United States during December, up 5.6 percent from a year earlier. The seasonally adjusted annual sales rate for domestic trucks was 6.2 million, compared with 5.9 million a year earlier and 6.6 million in October.

Imported car sales totaled 104,967, down one percent from a year ago, with a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.4 million. Imported truck sales rose 25 percent to 40,042, for an annual rate of 510,000.
